title: SB 10 (2025), Senate Enrolled Act 10, Public Law 70 — voter registration; proof of identification may not include a document issued by an educational institution
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id) (section) SEA 10 Sec. 1, IC 3-5-2-40.5(a)
(quote) Sec. 40.5. (a) Except as provided in subsection (b), "proof of identification" refers to a document that satisfies all the following:

(a_in_person_id) (section) SEA 10 Sec. 1, IC 3-5-2-40.5(a)(1)-(4)
(quote) (1) The document shows the name of the individual to whom the document was issued, and the name conforms to the name in the individual's voter registration record. (2) The document shows a photograph of the individual to whom the document was issued. (3) The document includes an expiration date, and the document: (A) is not expired; or (B) expired after the date of the most recent general election. (4) The document was issued by the United States or the state of Indiana.

(a_in_person_id) (section) SEA 10 Sec. 1, IC 3-5-2-40.5(c) (student-ID exclusion)
(quote) (c) The term does not include a document issued by an educational institution.

(b_no_id_remedy) (section) n/a
(quote) (x) not stated in SEA 10 (the enrolled act text does not address what a voter without proof of identification may do; the only appeal in the act concerns citizenship, below)

(b_no_id_remedy) (section) SEA 10 Sec. 5, IC 3-7-38.2-7.3(e) (citizenship appeal, not an ID remedy)
(quote) (e) An individual who is unable to provide documentation as proof of citizenship under this section may appeal in person or by mail to the county election board of the county in which the person was registered to vote.

(c_mail_ballot_id) (section) n/a
(quote) (x) not stated in SEA 10

(d_proof_of_citizenship) (section) SEA 10 Sec. 5, IC 3-7-38.2-7.3(a)
(quote) Sec. 7.3. (a) For purposes of this section, "proof of citizenship" means one (1) or more of the following: (1) The voter's birth certificate or a legible photocopy of the voter's birth certificate. (2) The voter's United States passport or a legible photocopy of the pages of the passport that identify the voter and show the passport number.

(d_proof_of_citizenship) (section) SEA 10 Sec. 5, IC 3-7-38.2-7.3(a)(3)-(5)
(quote) (3) The voter's United States naturalization documentation, a legible photocopy of the voter's naturalization documentation, or the voter's certificate of naturalization number.
(4) A document or method of proof of citizenship established under the Immigration Reform and Control Act of 1986 (8 U.S.C. 1101 et seq.). (5) The voter's consular report of birth abroad (CRBA).

(d_proof_of_citizenship) (section) SEA 10 Sec. 5, IC 3-7-38.2-7.3(c)
(quote) (c) After receiving a notice under subsection (b), the county voter registration office shall send a notice to the registered voter inquiring whether the individual is eligible to be registered to vote. An individual who receives a notice under this subsection shall, within thirty (30) days of receiving the notice, provide proof of citizenship to the county voter registration office in person or by mail.

(d_proof_of_citizenship) (section) SEA 10 Sec. 5, IC 3-7-38.2-7.3(d)
(quote) (d) If the individual does not provide proof of citizenship within thirty (30) days of receipt of the notice under subsection (c), the county voter registration office that issued the notice shall cancel the individual's registration.

(e_signature_or_records_verification) (section) SEA 10 Sec. 2, IC 3-7-26.3-11
(quote) Sec. 11. As required under 52 U.S.C. 21083, the county voter registration office shall perform list maintenance with respect to the computerized list on a regular basis within forty-eight (48) hours of receiving information that requires voter list maintenance activity.

(e_signature_or_records_verification) (section) SEA 10 Sec. 2, IC 3-7-26.3-11(5)
(quote) (5) a notice issued by a county voter registration office under IC 3-7-38.2-7.3 that the individual has not provided proof of citizenship.

(e_signature_or_records_verification) (section) SEA 10 Sec. 3, IC 3-7-38.2-2(l)
(quote) (l) A county voter registration office shall conduct a voter list maintenance program under this section for each voter who has not cast a vote in the two (2) most recent general elections.

(e_signature_or_records_verification) (section) SEA 10 Sec. 5, IC 3-7-38.2-7.3(b)
(quote) (b) The NVRA official shall compare the statewide voter registration system with the bureau of motor vehicles list of temporary credentials issued under IC 9-24-11-5(c) or IC 9-24-16-3(f).

(e_signature_or_records_verification) (section) SEA 10 Sec. 6, IC 3-7-38.2-19(a)
(quote) Sec. 19. (a) Not later than January 1, 2026, the secretary of state shall send a written or electronic communication to each state to request that the state or a group of states execute an agreement with Indiana to share certain information in the possession of the secretary of state and the other state or states for the purpose of: (1) maintaining the statewide voter registration list; and (2) identifying whether a voter of Indiana may also be registered to vote in another state.

(version) Enrolled (SB0010.04.ENRH, printed 03/27/2025; header reads 'SENATE ENROLLED ACT No. 10', running footer 'SEA 10 -- Concur'). Text is from pdftotext, so strike-through/underline marks are lost; the student-ID sentence in 3-5-2-40.5(c) is the new language.
(correction) Caller expected House passage 66-25. Official House roll call 340 on 2025-04-01 is 66 yea, 26 nay, 5 excused (66+26+5+3=100). Senate third reading 02/04/2025 is 39-11 (matches). Final enactment step was Senate concurrence (roll 352, 39-9, 1 excused) on 04/07/2025. The Stage 0 copy of this file had the House tally as 66-25 and the Senate date as "2025-02 (early Feb)", both from news; replaced by the official roll calls.
Sponsors as printed: Authored by Senators Doriot, Garten, Gaskill (API: Blake Doriot, Chris Garten, Mike Gaskill); House sponsor: Representative Culp (API: Kendell Culp); Cosponsors: Representatives Wesco and Miller D (API: Timothy Wesco, Doug Miller). Senate coauthors from the IGA API.
